description: After the faithful dagre-d3-es order() port (0 order mismatches vs reference on flowchart_complex/dedup_logic/subgraphs_styled), several cluster diagrams still render wider than mermaid: data_collection 1929 vs ref 1339, dedup_logic 1261 vs ref 823, clippy_fix 1113 vs ref 815, subgraphs_styled 1649 vs ref 1102, flowchart_complex 1538 vs ref 1274. Since orders match, the gap is in position (bk.rs) / node separation / cluster margins. Also SMSWorker/EmailWorker end up swapped vs reference despite matching dagre orders, pointing at mermaid's pre-dagre cluster-edge rewiring (anchor nodes) changing the input graph. See also follow-ups: anchor-node redirection + cutPathAtIntersect (mermaid-graphlib.js:252-288, edges.js:260-336), cluster rect bounds/padding constants (compute_bounds src/layout/graph.rs:169-210, render_subgraph src/render/svg/mod.rs:331-366 padding 20/title 25 vs mermaid 8/measured).
title: Position/BK parity: cluster diagrams widen with reference-correct orders
